Name: Finance Skill
Author: MarsXsyper
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Finance Skill adds a new custom skill to Stardew Valley centered around the financial side of farm life.

Earn Finance experience as you make money, increase the value of the items you sell as you level up, and choose between six professions that introduce new ways to interact with money, Prize Tickets, passive income, credit, cashback, and purchase discounts.

The skill features 10 levels, two level 5 professions, and four branching level 10 professions, each with its own mechanics.

[color=#D4D4D8]• Each Finance level increases the sell price of all items by 1%, up to +10% at level 10.

• Six unique professions with two distinct progression paths:
  - Couponist
    - Passive Income
    - Coupon Master
  - Credit Card
    - Cashbacker
    - Loyalty Program

• Receive Prize Tickets through the Couponist path and redeem them for enhanced rewards with Coupon Master.

• Generate daily passive income based on your current wallet balance.

• Use a fully functional credit system with credit limits, debt, monthly interest, automatic repayment, and a dedicated HUD.

• Expand the Credit Card system with cashback or discounted credit purchases through its level 10 professions.

• Credit Card support for regular shop purchases and backpack upgrades.

• Custom profession icons and a custom Coupon Master reward interface with gamepad support.

• Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6 using SMAPI and SpaceCore.[/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

Finance Skill adds a brand-new custom skill to Stardew Valley focused entirely on the financial side of farm life.

Instead of money being only something you earn and spend, Finance turns your economy into a progression system of its own. Earn Finance experience as you make money, increase the value of the items you sell, and unlock professions that introduce Prize Tickets, passive income, credit, cashback, discounts, and more.

The skill features 10 levels, two level 5 professions, and four branching level 10 professions.


FINANCE PROGRESSION

Whenever you receive money, you gain Finance experience equal to 1% of the amount received.

Every Finance level also permanently increases the sell price of all items by 1%.

At level 10, your items are therefore worth 10% more than their normal sell price.


PROFESSION TREE

Level 5

Couponist
├── Passive Income
└── Coupon Master

Credit Card
├── Cashbacker
└── Loyalty Program


COUPONIST

Level 5 Profession

Gain a 5% chance to receive a Prize Ticket by mail each morning.

Prize Tickets can be used normally at the Prize Machine in Mayor Lewis' house, making Couponist a simple way to gain additional access to its rewards over time.

Choosing Couponist unlocks Passive Income and Coupon Master at level 10.


PASSIVE INCOME

Level 10 — Requires Couponist

Receive 10% of your current wallet balance every morning.

There is no maximum payout.


COUPON MASTER

Level 10 — Requires Couponist

Turns the Prize Machine in Mayor Lewis' house into an enhanced version.

Each Prize Ticket still costs exactly one ticket, but instead of receiving one reward, Coupon Master gives you three rewards from the Prize Machine's normal reward progression.

The custom interface also previews your next three rewards.

Each reward advances the Prize Machine normally, meaning Coupon Master does not create a separate reward table or bypass its progression.

The custom Coupon Master interface also supports gamepad controls.


CREDIT CARD

Level 5 Profession

Credit Card introduces a complete credit system that allows you to make purchases even when you don't have enough money in your wallet.

Your available credit limit is equal to 20% of the highest amount of money you have earned during any completed month.

For example, if your highest completed monthly income was 100,000g, your credit limit will be 20,000g.

Your highest recorded monthly income never decreases, so reaching a particularly profitable month permanently establishes at least that level of credit.

When making a purchase, money from your wallet is always used first. Credit is only used for the remaining amount that your wallet cannot cover.

By default, the portion of a purchase financed with credit receives a 10% surcharge.

Your current available credit and used credit are displayed through a dedicated HUD element, which can be repositioned on the screen using mouse controls.


DEBT AND MONTHLY INTEREST

Credit Card debt persists until it is repaid.

Whenever you receive money while you have outstanding credit debt, that money is automatically used to repay the debt first.

At the end of the month, any remaining debt receives 15% interest.

If monthly interest is applied, the Credit Card becomes locked. You will not be able to use additional credit until the entire outstanding debt has been repaid.

Once the debt reaches zero, the card becomes available again automatically.


CASHBACKER

Level 10 — Requires Credit Card

Receive cashback based on the amount you actually financed with credit during the previous day.

Cashback is equal to 25% of the financed principal and is paid the following morning.

Only the amount actually financed through the Credit Card counts toward cashback — money paid directly from your wallet does not.

Cashback does not count as monthly income for Credit Card limit calculations.


LOYALTY PROGRAM

Level 10 — Requires Credit Card

Improves the terms of your Credit Card purchases.

Loyalty Program completely removes the normal 10% credit surcharge and reduces the credit-funded portion of purchases by 5%.

The discount only applies to the portion actually financed through credit. Any part paid directly from your wallet keeps its normal price.


SHOP AND BACKPACK SUPPORT

The Credit Card system works with regular shop purchases as well as backpack upgrades.

Shop prices dynamically account for the amount that would need to be financed, including Credit Card surcharges or Loyalty Program discounts when applicable.

Purchases that require credit are visually distinguished from purchases that can be paid entirely from your wallet (by the red numbers).


[size=4][b]Furure Plans[/b][/size]
-Adding ACTUAL coupons to use with the couponist and coupon master abilities.
-Adding new books that expand the skill effects and grant Finance XP.
-Giving more freedom and ways to use the Credit Card system.
-And more? All and any suggestions are welcome.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

Stardew Valley 1.6
SMAPI
SpaceCore


[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install SpaceCore.
3. Download Finance Skill.
4. Extract the "Finance Skill" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
